term: It's the Most Terrible Time of the Year
definition: It's the Most Terrible Time of the Year is an AI-generated television commercial created for McDonald's Netherlands by TBWA\Neboko and The Sweetshop.
details: It was released on 6 December 2025 before being pulled four days later due to negative reception over its use of generative artificial intelligence and its cynical, negative depiction of the holiday season.

explainer.lead: This is an AI-generated McDonald's Netherlands commercial that was pulled four days after release. It matters as a case of public backlash over generative AI use in advertising.

tiers.eli5: A big company made a Christmas ad with a computer program instead of filming everything, and people disliked it so much they took it down within a week.
tiers.practitioner: Marketers use generative tools to produce ads quickly, but this case shows audience rejection of visible AI use is a real rollout risk.
tiers.paperLevel: Not a technical method; it is a single commercial produced by TBWA\Neboko and The Sweetshop, released 6 December 2025 and withdrawn four days later. Its documented limits are reputational: negative reception cited both its generative AI use and its cynical holiday portrayal.

explainer.example: The ad aired for McDonald's Netherlands on 6 December 2025 and was removed four days later amid criticism of its AI generation and negative tone.
